craft_notes: Sthāyin: Devī's contentment (tuṣṭāham — SHE speaks: the asker of v23's beg now holds; the union begins). Sanskrit: devadeva mahādeva...tuṣṭāham...śaṅkara → L4 keeps god-of-gods address + content-am-I + held-today. Rows: row 2 (content→held). Close: today (adya — held TODAY: doctrine held now, not promised). Rejected: 'satisfied' — killed: content kept (tuṣṭi echoes v148/v150's contentment-refrain: the arc closes on its own word); 'the essence of the teaching' — killed: Rudrayāmala-tantra's essence kept (the NAMED tantra, never genericized).

lines: God of gods, great god — content am I, Śaṅkara:
l4.sanskrit_cite: devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam

reads_against.argmap: What does Devī say now? → Devī declared content — the tantra's essence is held today; union begins.
c1_essence: Devī: fully content — the tantra's essence held today.
